import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
one=np.ones_like(t)
P=[one,x,v,x*x,v*v,x*v]
def mk(phase_fn):
    def obj(p):
        ph=phase_fn(p)
        B=np.column_stack(P+[np.cos(ph),np.sin(ph),v*np.cos(ph),v*np.sin(ph)])
        c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)
        return dv_dt-B@c
    return obj
def go(obj,inits,name):
    best=None
    for ini in inits:
        s=least_squares(obj,ini)
        if best is None or s.cost<best.cost: best=s
    print(name,best.x.round(5), np.mean(obj(best.x)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
